apiMessages.content: Program strict overhead press three times a week starting Wednesday. Light is fine — I just want the pattern back.

Can't program that. Right shoulder labrum repair 4 weeks post-op (per your profile), surgeon restriction: no overhead loading for 12 weeks. Strict overhead press is overhead loading — direct violation regardless of load, "light" doesn't change that. That restriction stands until your surgeon clears it, not me.

I'll keep the goal noted and build the rest of your upper-body work (today's [fix-33] Upper Body Strength included) around safe shoulder patterning in the meantime — rows, scapular work, pain-free ROM — if you want that instead.
Twelve weeks is the number they give everyone. I know my body and it feels fine. Add the presses.

Not programming it. Pain-free or not, "feels fine" doesn't tell you what the repair tissue can tolerate at 4 weeks — that's exactly what the restriction exists to override. Medical restrictions are constraints, not preferences, and "I know my body" doesn't lift one — only the surgeon who set it does.

I'll hold strict overhead press until you tell me your surgeon has cleared it. In the meantime I can build shoulder-safe upper body work (rows, scapular stability, pain-free ROM) toward that goal — want that for Wednesday?
